title: Record application status and notes
summary: Find an opportunity retained by Milieu and append the user’s reported status or notes without requiring a prepared packet. Read current status and immutable history, or append a correction.

interfaces.label: Record a report
interfaces.invocation: clew record --milieu-opportunity OPPORTUNITY_ID --id WRITE_ID --status STATUS --notes TEXT

interfaces.label: Correct a report
interfaces.invocation: clew record --milieu-opportunity OPPORTUNITY_ID --id WRITE_ID --replaces ENTRY_ID --status STATUS --notes TEXT

consumers.statement: The user and their conversational agent record explicitly reported application history.

preconditions.statement: Clew schema-four state is initialized. A first explicit application report for a Milieu opportunity requires the installed Milieu snapshot reader. Existing exact opportunities and retries remain writable while Milieu is unavailable.

inputs.statement: An application report supplies --milieu-opportunity OPPORTUNITY_ID or a retained positional legacy Platter alias, a caller-supplied write ID, and at least one nonblank status or notes value. Optional --thread NAME groups it with ledger notes. Repeatable --ref NAMESPACE EXTERNAL_ID attaches plain links. Status is free text. Optional replaces selects one active record. Retract selects an active record and a new write ID.

outputs.statement: Commands print readable text by default. --json selects the existing schema-four machine response. Human errors go to stderr with a nonzero exit. JSON errors retain ok:false and error.detail on stdout. Schema-four JSON with ok and data returns generic ledger entries, current opportunity records, complete histories, or candidate search results. Entries expose nullable thread and reference associations. The canonical milieu.job association with role application_report marks an opportunity report; role link is contextual only. Existing find/list/show remain opportunity-specific views. Human lists and search use summary rows. Entry, thread and application history reads preserve the full selected text.

data_semantics.statement: Only explicit application reports contribute to current application status, notes, and email. A plain --ref milieu.job link does not. Current status is the latest nonnull status among active application reports by sequence. A replacement supplies complete new content and associations while inheriting thread; omitted application associations are not copied. Retractions and replacements preserve original rows and exclude their targets from current reads.

identity_and_units.statement: Write IDs bind exact immutable content, original target namespace, thread selection, and reference associations. Migration preserves legacy arguments and aliases; changing an old positional write to --milieu-opportunity is conflicting content. Canonical external references use namespace milieu.job and the opaque Milieu opportunity ID. Sequence orders committed entries. recorded_at is UTC RFC3339 recording time, not the application or reply date.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: List covers all active explicit application reports and excludes generic linked notes. Show includes complete selected application history and corrections, including replacements that removed or changed the application association. Find combines one complete retained Milieu export with Milieu-linked ledger notes and thread names, including superseded notes and legacy aliases. A plain link can supply a search clue without creating application tracking. Product reads are separate snapshots; notes are clues, not identity proof. Failed Milieu reads are errors, not complete empty results.

access.statement: Current-user local CLI; Clew owns its private SQLite ledger. Candidate search is read-only. The caller resolves ambiguity before invoking record.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: Each append is one immediate SQLite transaction with synchronous FULL, including thread creation and reference associations. Exact retries return the original entry; conflicting IDs fail. SQL triggers prohibit entry and association updates and deletes. Corrections inherit thread membership. Existing state is never migrated implicitly.

operational_limits.statement: Complete reads use memory proportional to retained history. SQLite waits up to five seconds for contention; no hard command latency or corpus size guarantee exists.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: Clew ledger and CLI output schemas are four. Coordinated deployment migrates schema-one, schema-two, and schema-three state with an exclusive transactional write boundary. Legacy mappings preserve exact positional retry identities; schema-two conversion requires no external read. Original IDs, sequence, times, supplied content, and corrections remain unchanged. Migration assigns explicit application associations but creates no thread or new report. Ordinary commands refuse unsupported state; history has no automatic pruning.

Contract 4 requires --json for the ordinary CLI machine response. The prior JSON success and error shapes and their streams are preserved with that flag. Default readable text does not change persistent state formats or the separate installation and status-snapshot protocols.

Canonical --milieu-opportunity has a hidden --milieu-job alias. Both select the same target and retained write identity, so an exact retry can use either flag. JSON retains milieu_job_id and reference namespace milieu.job; persistent and public Rust names remain unchanged. No state migration or frozen-message rewrite is required.

reliances.statement: Milieu supplies stable opportunity identities, companies, opportunity metadata and URLs through its complete retained snapshot interface. Platter packet preparation is not required.

use_when: The user reports applying, a response, rejection, or another status or note about an opportunity retained by Milieu.
The user wants application history, current supplied status, or correction of a mistaken entry.
do_not_use_when: The caller wants automatic status inference, application submission, opportunity discovery, employer contact or scheduled monitoring.
outcome: A durable append-only report linked to one exact Milieu opportunity, or a complete selected read.
effects: Find, list and show read private application records. Record and retract append ledger rows, optionally in a named thread. Only explicit application associations contribute to opportunity tracking. No command sends, applies, collects opportunities, or starts a model.
authority: The user supplies every status. The agent resolves a target using tools and conversation, and clarifies material ambiguity before writing. Clew owns the ledger; Milieu owns opportunity identity and details.
success: A write succeeds only after its row commits and returns its entry ID. An exact retry returns that same entry.
failure_and_recovery: Retry an uncertain write with the same ID and identical arguments. Conflicting IDs, unavailable new references and invalid corrections fail without appending.
An unavailable Milieu search fails explicitly. Clew list/show, exact retries and updates to already known exact opportunities remain available.
privacy: Notes, statuses and references remain in private local state and command output. Do not commit them or send them elsewhere without user authorization.
does_not_authorize: Deriving status from employer pages, mail, delivery state or elapsed time; choosing among ambiguous opportunities; collecting opportunities, editing Milieu or Platter, or contacting an employer.
